performance.verdict: CPL efficiency improving but spend collapse risks August prove-it scorecard.

findings.text: OVERDUE: Phone-match attribution gap (due 2026-08-07) and sync/contact cleanup (due 2026-08-14) both unresolved — August scoreboard cannot close without them.
OVERDUE: Renewal closed 2026-07-23 at $2,200 — prove-it month is live but no documented scoreboard baseline (patients scheduled/shown) exists in the data.
Spend dropped ~49% week-over-week to $30.63/day; leads fell 25.71% but CPL improved 31.94% to ~$11.43 — efficiency rose as budget compressed, ceiling not yet tested.
3-day signal (Aug 17–19): spend averaged $30.37/day vs $42.27 prior 3 days; leads averaged 5.7 vs 5.3 — CPL tightening even as spend falls, trend is holding.
GHL shows 85 opportunities created but 0 won and 0 appointments in 28 days against 124 leads — intake pipeline is not converting; this is a CRM/intake issue, not an ads problem.
